pages.title: Helmeted Musk Ox
pages.text: The helmeted musk ox ($(o)Bootherium bombifrons$()) lived across North America, from Alaska to Texas, during the Middle and Late Pleistocene.$(br2)It was taller and leaner than the living musk ox, with a longer snout, and in males the horn bases joined across the top of the skull in a solid bony helmet.$(br2)Males and females looked so different that they were once placed in separate genera. It died out about 11,000 years ago.
